mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, config_id, config_revision, scope_json, target_binding_id, target_revision, cluster_id, k8s_namespace, workload_uid, pod_uid, container_name, container_id, boot_id, content_digest, applied_revision, applied_digest, restart_digest, result, reason_code, reason_message, report_seq, receipt_digest, reported_at, applied_at, last_received_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ddc_config_process_receipt WHERE FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.manifest_json::text FROM ddc_config_item item JOIN ddc_config_version v ON v.tenant_id = item.tenant_id AND v.config_id = item.id AND v.config_revision = item.published_version WHERE item.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND item.id = #{configId} AND item.published_version = #{configRevision} AND item.deleted_at IS NULL AND item.deleted = false AND v.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.manifest_json IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE OF item
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ddc_config_process_receipt () VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.createUserId}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateUserId}, #{row.updateTime}, #{row.deletedAt}, #{row.version}, #{row.configId}, #{row.configRevision}, #{row.scopeJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=top.egon.cola.component.tianshu.admin.dao.typehandler.DdcJsonbTypeHandler}, #{row.targetBindingId}, #{row.targetRevision}, #{row.clusterId}, #{row.k8sNamespace}, #{row.workloadUid}, #{row.podUid}, #{row.containerName}, #{row.containerId}, #{row.bootId}, #{row.contentDigest}, #{row.appliedRevision}, #{row.appliedDigest}, #{row.restartDigest}, #{row.result}, #{row.reasonCode}, NULL, #{row.reportSeq}, #{row.receiptDigest}, #{row.reportedAt}, #{row.appliedAt}, #{row.createTime}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, config_id, config_revision, target_binding_id, target_revision, cluster_id, pod_uid, container_id, boot_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ddc_config_process_receipt WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (last_received_at > #{afterReceivedAt} OR (last_received_at = #{afterReceivedAt} AND id > #{afterId})) ORDER BY last_received_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
